title: Jaguars put Anton Harrison on injured reserve

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Jaguars put Anton Harrison on injured reserve
sources.description: A report on Tuesday morning said Jaguars left tackle Anton Harrison is headed for arthroscopic knee surgery and that his timeline for return won't be known until the operation takes place.
